question: The President of India _____ inaugurated Sangeet Natak Academi on 28 January 1953.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Prasad.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajendra Prasad** was the **first President of India** and served from **1950 to 1962**.
 
• **Sangeet Natak Academi **is an autonomous organization established by the **Indian government in 1952 t**o promote and preserve Indian music
